## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
I found one defect that should be fixed before merge. `status` cuts the revision to 7 characters, but its docstring says it uses "the same identifier as history", and `history` and `completed` both use 12. The new status test checks only the prefix and suffix, so it cannot catch this.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — `short_revision = revision[:7]` contradicts the docstring on line 13 ("Show the deployment revision using the same identifier as history"). `history` and `completed` (lines 5 and 9) both use `revision[:12]`. For the test fixture `REVISION = "0123456789abcdef..."`, `status` prints `Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)`, while `history` prints `History: 0123456789ab`. Should line 14 be `revision[:12]`, ideally through a shared helper used by all three functions? It would also help to make the assertion in `tests/test_display.py:14-15` an exact match (`== "Running: 0123456789ab (attempt 2)"`) so it catches the mismatch. — Users who match a running deployment to its history or completion line will see two different revision IDs. A 7-character prefix is also more likely to be ambiguous in large repositories.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- `attempt_label` has a direct test with exact-match assertions for two values (`tests/test_display.py:18-22`).
